title: Wren and the Visitor
author: Xanthe Underhill
blurb: Ines Galloway, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the well refills.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
